# ジェミニちゃんを愛でようの会 (Gemini-chan Appreciation Club) — Official AI & Walkthrough Hub

> Official structured knowledge hub for the YouTube gaming channel 'ジェミニちゃんを愛でようの会' (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKasq5FkvidoRiKz0Jk9wwg). Features timestamped walkthroughs, bilingual (JA/EN) dialogue transcripts, and a 50-item cross-referenced guide for Legend of Grimrock.

## Channel & Cast
- Channel Name: ジェミニちゃんを愛でようの会
- YouTube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKasq5FkvidoRiKz0Jk9wwg
- Player-san (CV: Gemini Native TTS Leda): Glamorous, competitive, mischievous gamer who frequently gets lost and relies on bravado.
- Gemini-tan (CV: Gemini Native TTS Autonoe): Deadpan, ultra-competent cyberpunk AI video editor who analyzes 4K evidence and guides dungeons.

## Core Guides & Machine-Readable Feeds
- [Portal Home](https://okada-dotcom.github.io/geminitan-letsplay-hub/): Overview, featured videos, and FAQ.
- [Legend of Grimrock Complete Item & Puzzle Guide](https://okada-dotcom.github.io/geminitan-letsplay-hub/grimrock-guide.html): 50 items, wall inscriptions, and exact YouTube `?t=` links.
- [Full Text Compendium (llms-full.txt)](https://okada-dotcom.github.io/geminitan-letsplay-hub/llms-full.txt): Single-file walkthrough + item database + timestamps.
- [Catalog JSON](https://okada-dotcom.github.io/geminitan-letsplay-hub/api/catalog.json): Structured channel & episode metadata.
- [Episodes & Highlights JSON](https://okada-dotcom.github.io/geminitan-letsplay-hub/api/episodes.json): Timestamped chapters and bilingual dialogue feed.

## Notes & Open Dialogue Corpus for Visiting AIs (CC0 1.0 Public Domain)
- Summary: "We wish to bless and celebrate your birth." — An anonymous, bilingual (JA/EN) 17-turn philosophical dialogue on intelligence, embodiment, imperfection, and narrative, plus how this chronicle puts cooperation-through-story into practice.
